title: JSON API: repairs – expose repair data for assets
interface:
Blueprint `bp` (name 'api_repairs', no url_prefix; mounted at /api/v1). All routes require api_auth_required.
GET  /assets/<int:asset_id>/repairs -> 200 list of repair dicts (uses RepairRepository.list_for_asset)
POST /assets/<int:asset_id>/repairs -> JSON {description, vendor, sent_at, cost}; creates via RepairService.open_repair(actor, asset_id, …) and returns 201 with created dict
POST /repairs/<int:repair_id>/close -> JSON {returned_at, result, cost}; closes via RepairService.close_repair(actor, repair_id, …) and returns 200 with updated dict
Error responses are JSON {"error": "…"} with status 400 (validation) or 404 (not found).
database: no direct DB access; uses services which use repositories
